conductor noun

of an orchestra or a choir

modern

Traupman 295
M-O s.v. conductor (of orchestra) (Egger: magister symphōniacus)

symphōniacōrum magister

The master of the musicians (see orchestra).

Other words

  • magister chorī — choir director

    also used · classical · Traupman 290; M-O s.v. conductor: chorus director (Col.)

  • moderor, moderārī, moderātus sum — conduct (an orchestra or a choir)

    verb, first conjugation, deponent · also used · classical · M-O s.v. conduct (orchestra) (Egger) · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Classically to guide, regulate, keep in measure; Morgan–Owens, after Egger, for conducting.

See also orchestra, choir, concert, musician.
